分析：1) 8kW采用4K×16的ROM.
需ROM 2个
剩余56kW采用8K×16的RAM
需RAM 7个.

2) 各片地址范围.（若从0000H开始）
ROM1 0000H~0FFFH
ROM2 1000H~1FFFH
RAM1 2000H~3FFFH
RAM2 4000H~5FFFH
RAM3 6000H~7FFFH
RAM4 8000H~9FFFH
RAM5 10000H~11FFFH
RAM6 12000H~13FFFH
RAM7 14000H~15FFFH.

ROM前缀码为A15 A14 A13 A12.
RAM前缀码为A15 A14 A13.

芯片    前缀码
ROM1    1110
ROM2    1111
RAM1    000
RAM2    001
RAM3    010
RAM4    011
RAM5    100
RAM6    101
RAM7    110

CS2 = 取反(A15 A14 A13 A12) = 取反(A15)+取反(A14)+取反(A13)+取反(A12)
CS3 = A15 + A14 + A13

CS8 = 取反(A15) + A14 + 取反(A13)
CS9 = 取反(A15) + 取反(A14) + A13
